verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents string labels on messages and threads, and labels can track conversation state. Nothing in the evidence describes selecting many conversations at once or applying archive, label, or done in a single bulk action. Per-thread labeling is an adjacent feature, not the bulk triage capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
